decisions.title: Sample data
decisions.text: The reconciled figures are the canonical design dataset v1 - internally consistent at every level, but not the organisation's real data and not represented as such. Replacing the values is expected; the relationships must hold.

decisions.title: ROI definition
decisions.text: Phase 1 reports return in outcomes, not naira. A verified outcome is a rise of at least one minimal important difference (8 points) on the seven-dimension index, with baseline and endpoint both present. Monetised ROI is designed and withheld until absence and attrition baselines are supplied.

open.title: Naira glyph
open.text: Inter draws the two bars of the naira sign slightly wide, so they overlap the first digit and read as a strikethrough. This affects every amount in the file equally, old and new - it is a font rendering artefact, not a design error. Switching the display format to NGN 12.37M would remove it, at the cost of touching roughly 500 labels.

open.title: Kept in-page tabs
open.text: 20 tab rows were kept deliberately: the Reports & ROI measurement ladder L1 to L4, the Settings sub-tabs, and Budgets, Allowances and Planning. They are in-page views rather than duplicates of a sidebar item. They can also move into the sidebar if you prefer total consistency.

open.title: Entry-point highlighting
open.text: Adjust Allowance Cap highlights Beneficiaries, and Adjust Cohort Budget highlights Programs. Both are plausibly entered from there, so this is a product decision rather than a defect.

open.title: Real figures
open.text: Every number in the file is the reconciled design dataset. Whoever owns the real figures needs to replace the values and confirm the relationships still hold.
